name: Van Loveren Tasting Room Klipheuwel
address: Klipheuwel Farm Stall, Klein Brak, Klein Brak River, 6506, South Africa
description_short: Wine tasting and light meals at a Garden Route farm stall showcasing Van Loveren's Robertson valley wines.
description_long:
Tucked into the Klipheuwel Farm Stall along the Garden Route, this Van Loveren tasting room brings the warmth of the Robertson valley to the Klein Brak River area. It's a relaxed spot where you can sample the estate's accessible, fruit-forward wines—from their popular Four Cousins range to more serious cultivars—paired with farm stall fare and light meals.

The setting is unpretentious and welcoming, with that easy farm stall charm where locals pop in for weekend tastings and visitors stock up on wine and provisions. The staff know their wines and guide you through the range without fuss. It's a handy stop between Mossel Bay and George, especially if you're after quality Cape wines without the Robertson drive.

Expect platters, light lunches, and country-style bites that complement the wines. The farm stall itself offers fresh produce, preserves, and local goods, making it a proper pit stop rather than just a tasting counter. Good for a leisurely afternoon or a quick wine run when you're in the area.
